title: Client Intake Voice Agent
summary: Answer inbound enquiries in Hindi and English, record facts and parties for a conflict check, spot urgent matters for an on-call advocate and book consultations, without giving legal advice.

seo.title: Client Intake Voice Agent for Law Firms | VipraTech
seo.description: A voice agent for law firms that takes enquiries in Hindi and English, captures facts for conflict checks, escalates urgent matters and books consults.

problem.intro: Firms handling property, family, consumer, employment and cheque dishonour matters get calls all day and after hours from people who are anxious and unsure what they need. Partners are in court, juniors answer between tasks, and important details such as opposing parties or an upcoming date go unrecorded, so conflict checks and urgent matters are delayed.

pain_points.title: Missed and unstructured calls
pain_points.detail: Calls during court hours go unanswered, and notes from answered calls lack the facts needed to assess the matter.

pain_points.title: Conflict checks happen too late
pain_points.detail: Opposing party names are not collected up front, so a conflict is discovered only after a consultation has been booked or held.

pain_points.title: Urgency not recognised
pain_points.detail: A caller with a hearing tomorrow, a limitation date approaching or fear of arrest needs a lawyer now, not a call-back next week.

pain_points.title: Callers ask for advice
pain_points.detail: Staff and tools are pushed to say whether the caller has a case, which only a lawyer should answer.

solution.overview: We build an inbound intake agent that answers the firm's enquiry line, says it is an AI assistant that cannot give legal advice, and asks for consent to record. In Hindi, English or a mix, it collects the caller's details, the type of matter, a short account of what happened, the names of other parties and any upcoming dates or deadlines. Urgent situations are transferred to the on-call advocate. Other enquiries go through a conflict check against your client and party records, and possible conflicts go to a partner before anything is booked. Cleared enquiries are booked for consultation, with a document checklist sent on WhatsApp.
capabilities: Hindi, English and Hinglish intake with clear AI and no-advice disclosure
Structured capture of matter type, facts, other parties and key dates
Urgency detection for hearings, limitation dates and personal safety, with live transfer
Conflict check against client and party records before booking
Consultation booking and a WhatsApp document checklist for the matter type
Intake memo written to the practice management system

workflow.title: Answer and disclose
workflow.detail: The agent answers, explains that it is an AI assistant that cannot give legal advice and asks for consent to record.

workflow.title: Capture the enquiry
workflow.detail: It records the caller's details, matter type, a short account of the facts, other parties and any upcoming dates.

workflow.title: Check urgency
workflow.detail: Imminent hearings, approaching deadlines or safety concerns trigger a live transfer to the on-call advocate.

workflow.title: Run the conflict check
workflow.detail: Names of the caller and other parties are checked against your client and matter records.

workflow.title: Partner review if needed
workflow.detail: Possible conflicts go to a partner, who decides whether the firm can act.

workflow.title: Book and send a checklist
workflow.detail: Cleared enquiries are booked for consultation, and the caller receives a document checklist.

inputs: Intake scripts and questions for each matter type
Client, matter and party records for conflict checks
On-call advocate roster and consultation calendar
Document checklists for each matter type
outputs: Structured intake memo for each enquiry
Conflict check results and partner decisions
Urgent transfers with a call summary
human_in_the_loop: Advocates handle every urgent matter live and give all advice in consultation. Partners decide on possible conflicts before the firm agrees to meet a prospective client.
integrations: Cloud telephony or existing office lines
guardrails: States at the start that it is an AI assistant and cannot give legal advice
Never assesses merits, predicts outcomes or quotes fees beyond the published consultation charge
Callers in danger are transferred to a person and given emergency numbers per firm policy
Inbound only, with no outbound promotional calls
Recordings and transcripts restricted to the intake team and retained per firm policy
compliance_notes: Bar Council of India rules restrict advocates from soliciting work or advertising, so the agent answers inbound enquiries only.
What prospective clients share is confidential and personal data under the DPDP Act 2023; access is restricted and retention limited.

pilot.scope: After-hours and overflow calls on the firm's enquiry line for one or two practice areas, with intake memos reviewed by an associate.
deliverables: Intake scripts and urgency rules agreed with partners
Working voice agent on the enquiry line

what_we_measure.how: Intake memos containing every required field, checked by an associate.
Urgent calls correctly identified and transferred, from call review.
Bookings made only after a completed conflict check.
Short post-call feedback and abandoned call counts.

faqs.q: Will callers think they are getting legal advice?
faqs.a: The agent says clearly at the start, and whenever asked, that it is an AI assistant and cannot give legal advice. It collects information and books time with a lawyer.

faqs.q: Is this consistent with Bar Council rules?
faqs.a: The agent only answers inbound calls to your own number and does not solicit work or advertise. We recommend your partners review the scripts against the rules your firm follows.

faqs.q: How does the conflict check work?
faqs.a: The agent collects the caller's name and the names of other parties and checks them against your client and party database. Possible matches go to a partner before any consultation is booked.
Callers who mention an imminent hearing, arrest or danger are transferred to a person at once, and given emergency numbers if they are in danger, following your firm's policy.
